supersedes_governance_only.head: d48d287480c30f182becbdaa5ca61c1b3a37a958
supersedes_governance_only.reason: v1 falsely claimed every helper failure necessarily leaves READY absent; reviewed helper can create READY and later fail while replacing or verifying CONTROL.

problem_statement.fact: The exact reviewed Codespace branch, local head, helper path, Codespaces environment and image identity were present, but the reviewed READY file remained absent after web attach.
unproven: whether postAttachCommand ran but its fixed PASS or DENIED output was not retained in the searched logs
whether the GitHub preflight itself would pass if the exact reviewed helper were invoked now
problem_statement.safety_state: At the observed checkpoint READY was absent and manual arm was not authorized. Root cause remains unproven.

bounded_recovery_candidate.purpose: Allow one separately reviewed manual invocation of the already-reviewed non-arm UI READY helper in the already-created exact Codespace, solely to perform the same current GitHub preflight and attempt to create an exact READY plus exact CONTROL pair on PASS.

success_required_evidence: exact READY file exists and binds the same Codespace name and image identity
exact CONTROL file contains PHASE_C_V19_7_36_V7R7_UI_READY and binds the same Codespace name and image identity
one_shot_semantics.failure_state_invariant: READY MAY BE ABSENT OR PRESENT; CONTROL MAY REMAIN PLACEHOLDER OR OTHERWISE FAIL EXACT SUCCESS VERIFICATION. NO STRONGER FILE-ABSENCE CLAIM IS MADE.
failure_required_actions: do not begin OAuth or device authorization
do not continue session or Runtime path
perform only read-only classification of READY and CONTROL state if Core requests it
mark this Codespace permanently nonreusable for helper, arm, OAuth, session and Runtime under this recovery chain

specific_attack_points: whether manual no-argument invocation as codespace user is semantically equivalent to reviewed postAttach helper invocation for executable, user, argument and network surfaces
whether exact fresh preconditions prevent stale, drifted, already-armed or different Codespace use
whether helper execution can start challenge, timer, OAuth, session gate or Runtime before separate arm authority
whether complete success requires both exact READY and exact CONTROL and cannot be inferred from helper exit or READY alone
whether partial failure after READY creation remains mechanically blocked by unchanged launcher CONTROL binding
whether consumed failure plus no retry plus permanent nonreuse is sufficient without claiming READY absence
whether read-only post-failure classification adds no authority and cleanup remains outside this gate
whether current live evidence binds exact head and image while preserving unproven postAttach root cause ceiling
whether any token, proxy, credential, capability, root, production, main/ruleset, workflow, secret or Runtime authority is added
